_note: Recorded from the distill-then-search ranker over 20 rank-scored cases. Eight cover ranking competencies (rare terms, decisions, multi-term coverage, phrases, typos, cross-project recall, old-strong vs recent-weak and a tight message against a long tool dump). Five are field-report cases on workflow discovery and evidence classes. Four are tier probes (the tier-1 inventory needle, the tier-1.5 FTS needle and the since/until temporal filters). Three cover the current session's family. A subagent holding the only answer outranks a weak outsider, a subagent whose reply echoes the query stays out only under excludeFamily:true, and a subagent only the slim index finds keeps a drill slot that its card-ranked siblings would otherwise take. One field-report case searches from a session whose subagent's delegated prompt echoes the query, so that subagent stays searchable, is demoted and must rank below the real workflow session. All 20 hit rank 1, so the aggregate is MRR 1.0 / recall@5 1.0. The output-only honest-miss/deep-hit pair and the virgin degraded-mode case are asserted directly in relevance.test.ts (negative/degraded, not rank-scored). New ranking engines must meet or beat these numbers. Update only intentionally, explaining why in the change-set.
